chg_pct = (end_close/start_close - 1)*100
high = df.loc[df['high'].idxmax()]
low = df.loc[df['low'].idxmin()]

print("=== 贵州茅台 (600519) 近一年分析 ===")
print(f"区间: {first['date'].date()} ~ {last['date'].date()}  共 {len(df)} 个交易日")

print(f"区间涨跌幅: {chg_pct:+.2f}%")
print(f"最高价: {high['high']:.2f} ({high['date'].date()})")
print(f"最低价: {low['low']:.2f} ({low['date'].date()})")
print(f"振幅: {(high['high']/low['low']-1)*100:.2f}%")
print(f"日均成交额: {df['amount'].mean()/1e8:.2f} 亿元")
print(f"日均换手率: {df['turnover'].mean():.2f}%")

# 月度表现
df['ym'] = df['date'].dt.to_period('M')

monthly['涨跌幅'] = (monthly['收']/monthly['开']-1)*100
print("\n=== 月度表现 ===")
for idx, r in monthly.iterrows():
    print(f"{idx}: 收 {r['收']:.2f}  月涨跌 {r['涨跌幅']:+.2f}%")

# 保存数据供后续使用
df.to_csv("/tmp/moutai_600519.csv", index=False)
print("\nsaved")
"}
